rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: one yard tree for every two or three houses, in back yards and at lot corners, never against a fence or a wall (zone 813 -> about 400)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The quadrant's sixteen builder trees go (ficus, corals and jacarandas along the back fences, a magnolia and a jacaranda 3 m from the house fronts, a few in the yards inside the wrought-iron fence); five come back on their own spots, about one for every two houses: by the swing set, on the open lot corner, in two yards inside the iron fence, and one on the old back fence row.

trees.why: the back yard with the swing set (2.8 m off): shade over the swings
the open lot corner inside the wrought-iron fence, 26 m from the walls: a full magnolia
the yard north of it, 10.6 m from the house, 31 m from the magnolia
the middle yard inside the same fence, 11.7 m from the house
the north back fence row, 7.7 m from the house: the row's one tree (it had one every 6-20 m)
